declared_before: any trade return, control return, delta, profit factor, win rate, TP rate or SL rate of this rule set on any data; the MDE noise estimation runs after this file's checksum is recorded
prior_exposure: D-AGG-2 X-8: setup vs full-universe mean and median close_return_5 and excess_return_5 (time-exit, no TP/SL, not vs a volatility-matched control)
D-AGG-2 X-7: volatility-matched TL 1.079 / DL 1.026 (tail probabilities, not returns)
D-AGG-2 X-9: MFE/MAE deciles of setup and universe
none of these is a trade return of this rule set against this control

sample.setup: D0 setup rule: per session, signal-OK queries by A(q) descending, sample_rank ascending, first ceil(1/10 x n_ok), selected before validity
sample.session_drop: a session with fewer than 20 valid setup trades, or with a setup decile that has no valid control row, is dropped from every statistic, counted

trading_rule.price_basis: x(t)/F(t), F cumulative over splits executed <= t (D-AGG-1 excursion basis)
trading_rule.entry: P0 = O(D+1)/F(D+1), the first price after the signal at D close; D is never an entry
trading_rule.entry_gap: no TP/SL test at the entry print itself; the entry session's high and low are tested after entry
trading_rule.comparison: a level counts as touched when price/P0 - 1 >= +0.10 - 1e-12 (TP) or <= -0.10 + 1e-12 (SL), D-AGG-1 THRESHOLD_EPS
trading_rule.session_1: intraday on D+1: if high touches TP and low touches SL -> exit at SL; else if low touches SL -> exit at SL; else if high touches TP -> exit at TP
trading_rule.sessions_2_to_5: for k = 2..5 in order, if session D+k has a bar: if open touches SL -> exit at that open; else if open touches TP -> exit at that open; else intraday as in session_1; a session without a bar is skipped (no trading possible), never replaced by D+6
trading_rule.same_bar_ambiguity: SL FIRST (conservative): a bar whose high touches TP and low touches SL exits at SL
trading_rule.gap_exit: a gap through a level exits at the open price, not at the level (worse than SL on a gap down, better than TP on a gap up)
trading_rule.time_exit: no level touched by the end of D+5 -> exit at C(D+5)/F(D+5)
trading_rule.validity: a trade exists only where the D-AGG-1 excursion is valid (bar on D+1 with open > 0, bar on session D+5, not label CA suspect); every other row is NO_TRADE and counted
trading_rule.missing_final_bar: NO_TRADE (MISSING_HORIZON_BAR): a trade whose D+5 bar is absent is undecidable under this contract
trading_rule.delisting_or_halt: indistinguishable inside the window; treated as missing_final_bar; no exit price is invented
trading_rule.symmetry: the same rule, validity and cost apply to setup and control rows
trading_rule.known_bias: NO_TRADE on a missing D+5 bar drops trades that may have ended in delisting losses; applies to both groups equally and is disclosed with counts

cost.primary: COST_10BP: net_return = gross_return - 0.0010 per trade (E-D6 primary scenario)
cost.delta_note: a flat per-trade cost cancels in Delta; it only moves the absolute net expectancy condition
cost.limitation: 10 bp may understate friction for low-priced high-volatility names; no price or volatility multiplier without a new evidence-backed declaration (E contract rule)

control.population: session D's as-of eligible universe (D-AGG-1 universe rows), before any future validity is known
control.matching_variable: rv_20 of session D (V2-A structure coordinate: std_ddof1 of ln(P(t)/P(t-1)), t in D-19..D)
control.buckets: 10 deciles: edges = numpy.quantile(population rv_20, [0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.9]) with the default linear method; bucket = searchsorted(edges, rv_20, side='right') in 0..9
control.edge_population: the whole as-of population, setup members included; validity is not consulted
control.setup_excluded: rows whose ticker is in that session's setup are removed from the control after edges are built
control.weights: w_j(t) = valid setup trades in bucket j / valid setup trades, session t
control.control_expectancy: E_C(t) = sum_j w_j(t) x mean net_return of the valid non-setup control rows in bucket j
control.empty_bucket: if w_j(t) > 0 and bucket j has no valid control row the session is dropped (counted); no neighbouring bucket is borrowed

estimand.session_setup: E_S(t) = mean net_return of the valid setup trades of session t
estimand.primary: Mean Delta = equal-session mean of Delta(t) over the retained sessions
estimand.absolute: Mean setup net expectancy = equal-session mean of E_S(t)

statistics.bootstrap: moving block over retained sessions, non-circular, block 20, 10000 replicates, percentile, 95% two-sided
statistics.ticker_contribution: c_i = sum over ticker i's valid setup trades of (net_return - E_C(t)) / n_S(t), ties by ticker column ascending
statistics.leave_out: drop the 5 sessions with the largest Delta(t) and recompute Mean Delta; separately drop every row of the 10 tickers with the largest c_i from setup and control on every session and recompute (the 20-trade rule re-applied)

mde_gate.purpose: decide whether a backtest can detect a delta of practical size before it is built
noise_inputs_allowed: sd of per-trade setup net return (demeaned inside the estimator)
sd of the Delta(t) series (demeaned inside the estimator)
lag-1 autocorrelation of the demeaned Delta(t) series
bootstrap standard error of Mean Delta (spread of replicate means; location removed)
forbidden_outputs: the sign of any location statistic
mde_gate.estimator_location: scratchpad script outside the repository; prints only the allowed fields
mde_gate.se_used: SE_block = standard deviation over the 10000 replicate means of Delta(t), draws from block_indices(T, horizon=5, block_length=20, replicates=10000, seed=2026092100)
mde_gate.limit: MDE80 <= 0.0050 per trade -> MDE_PASS; MDE80 > 0.0050 -> D_AGG_MDE_STOP (0.0050 exactly passes; the decision note stops only when MDE exceeds 0.50%)
mde_gate.on_stop: D-AGG research CLOSED, backtester NOT BUILT, no rule or control change, no retry
mde_gate.on_pass: backtester implementation authorized for this contract only

backtest_gate.name: GATE-D-AGG-BACKTEST

conditions.P1_validity: execution PIT audits pass with 0 violations; retained sessions >= 150 and dropped sessions <= 5; valid setup trades >= 5000; setup NO_TRADE share <= 0.02 and <= 2 x control NO_TRADE share
conditions.P4_delta_interval: 95% bootstrap CI lower bound of Mean Delta > 0
conditions.P5_blocks: Delta block mean > 0 in >= 3 of 4 blocks
conditions.P6_leave_out: Mean Delta without the top 5 sessions > 0 and Mean Delta without the top 10 tickers > 0
conditions.P7_concentration: largest single-ticker share of the sum of positive ticker contributions <= 0.05 (D0 H7 value)

verdict.D_AGG_BACKTEST_FAIL: any of P2 through P7 fails, or P1 fails on a PIT violation or a sample condition
verdict.D_AGG_BACKTEST_INCONCLUSIVE_TECHNICAL: only data corruption or an execution failure that prevents computing the statistics; never a statistical outcome

backtest_gate.no_borderline: the borderline decision was one-time; a statistically marginal result is FAIL

secondary.role: descriptive only, reported in full, never a gate input

rules.S1_time_exit_only: same entry, no TP/SL, exit at C(D+5)
rules.S2_same_bar_tp_first: same rule with same-bar ambiguity resolved TP first

descriptives: TP / SL / time-exit / gap exit shares
setup and control expectancy per block
secondary.profit_factor_role: reported, not a gate: the decision note declared no profit factor threshold

forbidden: block, session, ticker or theme exclusion beyond the declared leave-out
a second matching variable in the primary control
reading any location statistic before the MDE gate

authorizations.backtester: only after MDE_PASS and only for this contract
